solution: Ta có <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mo>cos</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mover><mi>a</mi><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mover><mi>b</mi><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mfrac displaystyle="true"><mrow><mover><mi>a</mi><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover><mo>⋅</mo><mover><mi>b</mi><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover></mrow><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">|</mo><mover><mi>a</mi><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">|</mo></mrow><mo>⋅</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">|</mo><mover><mi>b</mi><mo accent="true">→</mo></mover><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">|</mo></mrow></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mfrac displaystyle="true"><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow></semantics></math>.
